item.title: 7.6 Magnitude Earthquake Hits Japan; Tsunami Warning on Northern Coast
item.description: A 7.2 magnitude earthquake has hit Japan, according to the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA), Reuters reported, adding that a tsunami warning has also been issued. Reports suggest that the earthquake struck off the coast of Aomori and Hokkaido, adding that a tsunami as high as three metres (10 feet) could hit Japan’s northeastern coast. item.title: Assam’s Young Swimmer Wins Silver Medal at Asian Youth Games
item.description: Young swimming star from Assam, Tirthank Pegu, delivered a stellar performance at the Asian Youth Games held in Bahrain, winning the silver medal in the 200-metre butterfly event. On Thursday, 30 October, India’s Tirthank Pegu clocked 2:02.56 to secure the second position, finishing just behind Iran’s Mohammad Mahdi Gholami, who clinched gold with a timing of 2:01.75. item.title: Tezpur University Row: NSUI Lodges FIR Against Ex VC Shambhu Nath Singh
item.description: The National Students' Union of India (NSUI), Assam, has filed an FIR today against former Vice-Chancellor Shambhu Nath Singh of Tezpur University in every district, demanding his immediate arrest.
